basic_info.description: Don't miss this bright top-floor 2 bedroom 1 bathroom TIC unit that borders lower Pacific Heights. Situated on a peaceful, tree-lined street, this unit offers a blend of style and comfort in a great location. The spacious primary bedroom features classic bay windows and great natural light overlooking the quaint street. The common area features an open kitchen living situation, with direct access to a small porch that leads to the shared backyard. Additional storage is located in the basement of the building.
